relation_initial_prompt: Learn a reusable compact legal relation program from these TRAIN policies only. No case answers are available. Use predicates with explicit named argument roles, including distinct claimant/subject or parent/child and year where relevant. Every term is a string: ?x is a rule variable, other strings are literal constants (including years and amounts). A rule head follows from the conjunction of body atoms, with exact sign positive true/false; false is EXPLICIT negative evidence, never negation-as-failure. different pairs specify inequality for another taxpayer, never invent facts. Every head/distinct variable must occur in a body atom. Declare a neutral case_subject_year(person,year) relation, used only to enumerate the subjects/years actually named in case/query, so general amount rules are range-restricted. functional true means a terminal relation with last argument the output value and earlier arguments its key. Only nonfunctional relations may occur in rule bodies; reserve functional for final amounts. Priorities higher/lower are rule IDs supported by exact policy quotes, applying only when same keyed functional conclusions compete. Do not put a final legal conclusion in an undeclared external Boolean. Explicitly connect stated qualifying child/relative to dependent and deduction allowable to another person to its subject. Translate ONLY151(c),151(d)(1),(2),(5),152(a),152(b)(1) and their applicability predicates. For151(d)(2) derive both its applicability and its zero exemption effect;151(d)(5) may use an explicitly declared factual year-period relation as unresolved if arithmetic is not expressible. Do not implement a test or final answer. Other subrules not in this requested local module remain unresolved. guard_quote is the complete exact antecedent phrase, excluding its consequent; quote is an exact full governing sentence. All guard_quote/quote strings must be nonempty exact substrings of supplied policy. Source headings are not sufficient evidence for an invented legal condition. Use one consistent predicate vocabulary across these two policies. Return only the schema object.
